G55's readings 1 and 2, stated while reading K03's instantiate window i569_000 (25 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (1) A call, plan or attack on a team, school, brand or nation that the room's community rivals from before the canvas is AT (2007scape c1239, bostonbruins c0015, cardinals c0063, chibears c0109), and so is a refusal to help the old rival (buffalobills c0087). A boast or joke that recalls an old result, such as 7-1, EURO 1-0 or Pele over Maradona, is TA (argentina c0122, brasil c0064, PORTUGALCARALHO c0017). Naming the old rival as the vandals is NR (aggies c0047), as is giving the canvas contest an old rivalry's name, such as the Ashes or the Battle of Alberta (australia c0081, alberta c0030). A member who sets the quarrel aside for the canvas, and names it as old, is ST (2007scape c1242, calgaryflames c0203). (2) The other party may be a camp with its own sub: the Bitcoin scaling camps (r/bitcoin and r/btc) count as rival subs, though a member calls it the community's internal struggle (bitcoin c0282, c0302; btc c0121); a feud with no sub of its own stays with K04. A national dispute between two parties, such as Quebec and Canada, carried into flag talk is NR (canada c0295); arguing the nation's history with no other party stays with K04. An old dispute with the site's admins carried into a slogan or a protest sign is NR (anarchism c0003, c0115). A quarrel shown only after the close is AC (albania c0064). Next: K03-inst-spec-1.txt
